window_source: Recorded Replay; unchanged windows applied to both methods
rms_definition: Native120Hz right-endpoint equal-interval RMS. sqrt(sum(angle_deg^2)/N), with start_tick_exclusive < tick <= end_tick_inclusive. Source is the complete streamed native aggregate, not15Hz video reconstruction; no trapezoidal weighting.
FR_pooling: sqrt((FR1_RMS^2*N1 + FR2_RMS^2*N2)/(N1+N2)); same result as pooling squared-angle integrals and durations. Never average RMS values.
sampling: Bars and summary statistics: original120Hz aggregates. Curve and rendered snapshots: actual retained15Hz link-pose samples, without interpolation.
